name: ableton-ai-music-coach
description: An AI-powered music production teacher and desktop workstation for Ableton Live 12
author: AI Studio User

scripts.electron:build: node scripts/generate-branding.js && npm run build && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/main.js && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('electron/splash.html', 'dist-electron/splash.html'); require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap add android || true && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.js && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
